description: Turns the sixteen buttons of the Smasher immediately to its left into gate outputs, with a vMIDI output beside them

outputs.text: 10V while the button of the same number on the Smasher is pressed or latched on, and 0V otherwise
A vMIDI cable carrying the controller messages arriving from the hardware, for Kilpatrick's patchable MIDI modules rather than for a voltage input

notes: it goes immediately to the right of a Smasher and puts out nothing on its own
menu: MIDI Output Mode: CC, Piano Major, Piano Chroma — sets whether the vMIDI output carries the buttons as controller messages or as notes, laid out as a major scale or one semitone apart
